title: ilex pedunculosa f. aurantiaca
intro: Ilex pedunculosa f. aurantiaca, commonly known as the golden-leafed holly, is a plant species in the Ilex genus. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, potentially aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Ilex pedunculosa f. aurantiaca include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
